# Environment asset credits

All models in this folder come from free packs released under **CC0 1.0** (public domain).
Attribution isn't required, but credit is given gladly.

| Pack | Author | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| Medieval Hexagon Pack | Kay Lousberg — KayKit (kaylousberg.com) | Hex terrain for every island, the harbour and the settlement; First Harbour's town buildings, walls and towers; mountains, trees, rocks and clouds; camp and farm props |
| Dungeon Remastered | Kay Lousberg — KayKit (kaylousberg.com) | Paving, stairs and the shrine pillar in First Harbour; torches and banners; the Colossus's chest plate and the arena's ruined pillars |
| Castle Kit | Kenney (kenney.nl) | The wind beacon tower and siege engines in First Harbour |
| Nature Kit | Kenney (kenney.nl) | Wretch isle forest, flowers and undergrowth; stand-in themes on isles awaiting Quaternius packs (recoloured to match the KayKit palette) |
| Pirate Kit | Kenney (kenney.nl) | Docks and lighthouse; Smuggler's cove: palms, huts, watchtower, cargo, wreck |
| Watercraft Kit | Kenney (kenney.nl) | Boats, ships and buoys in the harbour and along the ocean route |
| Modular Cave Kit | Kenney (kenney.nl) | Rock arches around the rim settlement and the Colossus gate |
| Modular Dungeon Kit | Kenney (kenney.nl) | Ruined gates in the Drowned Colossus arena |

Generated by `npm run build-env` from the packs downloaded by `npm run fetch-assets`.
